player_prompt.intro:
I ye Jokori {player_id} o German Whist.
{phase_info}
I tɛ {hand_size} karti.
Jɛ karti [play N], N ye i kɔnɔ (sɛbɛn '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: Kalan FASƐN: a sɔrɔbaa bɛ ka kadi ɲɛfɛla ta ani bɔnɛbaga b'a tɔɲɔgɔn dɔ wɛrɛ minɛ. O la, kalan minnu kɛra nin waati in na olu tɛ jate selifɛn ye.
player_prompt.phase_playing: Ɲininkali: boloda bɛ ban. Ko bɛɛ b'a jira ko a ye se sɔrɔli kɛ.

next_card.playing_phase: Kariti si tɛ kɛ - tulon daminɛna.
next_card.deck_empty: Kariti tɛ yen - kariti si ma di.

phase.learning_complete: Jate bɛ ban. Kalan labanna - kalan tɔ bɛɛ ye se sɔrɔli kɛ ko kura ye.
